title: METTLER TOLEDO: PHP2Shell in Octo Image Server
description: A critical vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-109618 affects the Octo Image Server component of METTLER TOLEDO products, specifically versions up to 5.0.10. The vulnerability involves a PHP2Shell issue, which could potentially allow unauthorized code execution. Although the product is typically deployed within internal networks and not exposed directly to the internet, updating the PHP package to version 8.2.35 is recommended to mitigate any potential risk and align with cybersecurity best practices.
